name: PadText
label: Pad Text
description: Creates a fixed-length text by adding characters to the left or right of an existing text.

fields.name: PaddingDirection
fields.label: Padding Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to pad the text on the left or right side.

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Pad the text on the left side.

selectOptions.label: Right
selectOptions.description: Pad the text on the right side.

fields.name: PaddingCharacter
fields.label: Padding Character
fields.description: The character(s) to use for padding.

fields.name: TotalLength
fields.label: Total Length
fields.description: The desired total length of the padded text.
